name: Chicago (Swedish)
description: Chicago (Swedish): 2â€“4 players, 52 cards. Three phases per hand: (1) draw then claim best poker hand for points; (2) draw again, claim again; (3) draw then play tricks, no trumps; last trick scores 5. Declare Chicago to take all 5 tricks for 15 or lose 15. First to 52 wins.

setup.players: 2â€“4; dealer chosen at random, rotates clockwise.
setup.dealing: 5 cards each, one at a time.

rules.objective: Score points for best poker hand in phases 1â€“2 and for best hand at end of phase 3; 5 points for last trick. First to 52 wins. Chicago: declare to take all 5 tricks for +15 or -15.
rules.gameplay: Phase 1â€“2: discard/draw, then announce best poker combination (pair to royal straight flush); highest scores 1â€“8 pts. Phase 3: discard/draw, then play tricks; must follow suit; last trick = 5 pts; then best poker hand scores again.
keyRules: Three phases: claim poker twice, then tricks
Chicago: all 5 tricks = 15, else -15; need 15+ to declare

strategy.basic: Improve hand in phases 1â€“2; in phase 3, save high cards for last trick.
strategy.intermediate: Claim only when you can back it up; declare Chicago when hand guarantees five tricks.
strategy.advanced: Four of a kind: score 7 or zero others; 46+ lock-in.

variations.name: Four of a kind reset
variations.description: Player with four of a kind may score 7 points or reset all other players' scores to zero; hand ends if reset.
